profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Nice to meet you! I am a full stack software engineer based out of Orange County, CA. 

I've been drawn to tech my whole life, all the way back to creating HTML fan-sites for my favorite cartoons as a kid, and later writing custom CSS for my Myspace profile as a teenager.

I rediscovered my passion for coding after years of hiring software engineers as a technical recruiter.  My goal is to be living proof that you can step into a successful software engineering career at any stage of life, for free, with the help of your community.

These days, I create custom webpages and web applications for clients using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, Node, and more.  I am also working on some exciting projects through "tech night" in Orange County - we host social meetups, hackathons, conferences, and more!

Feel free to drop a line if you'd like to talk tech or if you are looking for a new dev to join your team.  I'm also happy to give free advice to engineers looking to get their start (my technical recruiting experience has proven helpful for folks hoping to break in!).

Portfolio: https://jacquelinetaylor.netlify.app/
Github: https://github.com/jax644

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
V.Two is a software development firm focused on innovation, agility, and transformative impact.

I work on international teams for various clients, primarily focused on web development using JavaScript, React, Redux, Material UI, and Firebase.

Additionally, I designed, developed, and deployed V.Two's official site: https://www.vtwo.co.
positions.insights: Skills: Redux.js · Firebase · Material-UI · JavaScript · TypeScript · Node.js · Git · React.js · Front-End Development · Responsive Web Design · Web Application Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
100Devs is a software engineering agency and training program focused on delivering high-quality web development and application solutions.

During my time with 100Devs, I had the unique opportunity to work on real-world client projects while simultaneously advancing my technical skills. I built full-stack, responsive websites and applications across diverse industries, contributing directly to the development and deployment of these solutions. The program’s curriculum included foundational and advanced software engineering concepts, such as Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), MERN stack development, and the full lifecycle of app development—from ideation to deployment.

In addition to hands-on development, I gained valuable experience in best practices for collaboration, including working in large teams, version control with Git and GitHub, and managing client relationships. This hybrid learning environment allowed me to develop both my technical abilities and professional skills, all while delivering real-world, impactful work for clients.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Computer Science · JavaScript · Web Development · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Express.js · HTML5 · Node.js · MongoDB · Git · React.js · Front-End Development · Responsive Web Design · Web Application Development

positions.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
Sparks’ mission is to curate tailor-made experiences and ignite joy in every vacation rental. By offering bespoke design transformations and impeccable property management, we create extraordinary memories that last a lifetime.

Responsibilities and Achievements:
-Web Design: Designed and maintained a custom website to professionally showcase rental properties.
-Optimized Online Listings: Managed VRBO and Airbnb listings, increasing visibility and booking rates.
-Content Creation: Produced engaging property descriptions and visual content, ensuring consistent branding across platforms.
-Digital Marketing Strategy: Implemented SEO and targeted advertising strategies to attract guests and drive bookings.
-Streamlined Operations: Integrated booking systems and managed guest communications to ensure a seamless experience.

positions.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Advisor
positions.description:
West Monroe is a digital services firm that provides traditional management consulting and product engineering services to businesses across many industries.  

I was a Senior Talent Acquisition Advisor within West Monroe's Product Engineering Practice.  My role blended traditional technical recruitment and talent acquisition leadership, specifically blending recruitment strategy between West Monroe and its two recently acquired companies, Carbon5 and Verys (where I was the head of talent acquisition).

Responsibilities and Achievements:
-Created a Unified Interview Process: Collaborated with leaders across acquired companies to create a standardized interview process, incorporating best practices from Verys.
-Elevated Technical Hiring: Oversaw senior engineers in developing new coding challenges, ensuring strong assessments for various roles.
-Architected Talent Strategy: Partnered with leadership to define ideal candidate profiles, refine search strategies, and set clear long-term recruiting goals.
-Expanded Sourcing Network: Established new partnerships (Out in Tech, CINDE) and transitioned successful Verys partnerships (NSBE, CodePath) to broaden candidate pool.
-Streamlined Candidate Lifecycle: Collaborated with a focus group to improve every touchpoint of the candidate experience at West Monroe.
-Technical Recruiting: Gathered position requirements, wrote and published job postings, reviewed resumes, conducted phone screens, facilitated technical interviews, debriefed with hiring managers, and contributed to hiring decisions for Software Engineer positions.

Tools & Technology: Greenhouse ATS, LinkedIn Recruiter, Microsoft Office

positions.title: Director of Recruiting
positions.description:
Verys was a multi-disciplined technology delivery organization that offered a strategic approach to building software through user-centered design, modern development architecture, and business alignment - providing a compelling alternative to offshoring.

As the Director of Recruiting, I managed all aspects of talent acquisition and contributed to all hiring decisions.  Additionally, I led many of our employee groups, company initiatives, and external partnerships.

Responsibilities and Achievements:
-Built & Led High-Impact Recruiting: Managed all talent acquisition efforts for a 100+ person software firm, exceeding hiring goals (averaging 9 hires/month) while maintaining client satisfaction & employee retention.
-Sourcing Expertise: Utilized LinkedIn, Indeed, & targeted partnerships (NSBE, CodePath) to attract top talent from a diverse candidate pool (including Software Engineers, Data Engineers, and Project Managers).
-Streamlined Interview Process: Revamped interview process, creating question banks, authoring and administrating training protocols, and leading post-interview decision meetings.
-Cultivated Award-Winning Culture: Contributed to Verys' 4.7-star Glassdoor rating through focus on employee well-being and engagement.

Tools & Technology: CATS One ATS, Greenhouse ATS, LinkedIn Recruiter, Microsoft Office

positions.title: Recruiting Manager
positions.description:
VincentBenjamin is a boutique staffing agency specialized in permanent and contract placement in IT, finance, and accounting.

As the Recruiting Manager, I worked with hiring managers and candidates to fill permanent technical job openings in Orange County and Los Angeles.

Responsibilities and Achievements:
-Ran a "full-desk", working with clients and candidates on IT permanent placements at all levels of seniority 
-Managed full-cycle recruitment: Needs assessment, technical screening, interview scheduling and debrieﬁng, feedback discussion, salary negotiation, pre-closing, closing, and consistent follow up post-placement 
-Built meaningful relationships with active and passive candidates to uncover the intangible motivators driving their career decisions
-Sourced qualified candidates using a plethora of tools, websites, networking events, referrals, and our internal database
-Prospected new clients using complex and strategic search tools and queries. Initiated contact with highly specialized and personalized sales pitches. 
-Nurtured client relationships via frequent oﬃce visits, lunch meetings, and virtual calls to discuss business needs and the desired qualities for new hires 
-Consistently exceeded performance metrics, including 250+ dials / week and 75+ internal interviews / week

positions.title: Account Manager, Home Design Trade
positions.description:
As the Trade Account Manager, I served professionals enrolled in our design trade program as their point of contact for all matters related to Houzz purchases and project planning.

Responsibilities and Achievements:
-Established and maintained relationships with 500+ design professionals and businesses via cold calling, successful project management, and consistent follow-up 
-Drove new enrollments to the Trade Program with the aim of selling and up-selling e-commerce products 
-Provided project assistance from concept to completion: product curation, online visualization, proposals and invoices, negotiated pricing, bulk shipment planning, delivery coordination, and post-purchase problem-solving 
-Selected to represent the Trade team as a panel speaker for recruiting and training events 
-Proactively wrote and distributed email templates for company-wide use 
-Analyzed product margin, shipping costs, and trade discounts to maximize proﬁt 
-Collaborated with senior management across departments to improve daily internal processes

positions.title: Sales Representative, E-Commerce
positions.description:
As the E-Commerce Sales Representative, I served shoppers as a design consultant and product expert on Houzz's 10-million product marketplace.
 
Responsibilities and Achievements:
-Excelled in sales: #2 top seller of 30 in Q4 2017 with $358,639 shipped sales; 29% conversion 
-Established a book of business with recurring customers through consistent follow-up 
-Delivered a presentation on workplace positivity and sales strategy at the request of leadership 
-Provided supplemental training and mentorship for new hires

positions.title: Customer Service Representative, E-Commerce
positions.description:
As the Marketplace Operations Coordinator, I liased between customers, vendors, shipping partners, and various internal departments to provide the best experience on the Houzz e-commerce platform.

Responsibilities and Achievements:
-Fielded and resolved e-commerce customer service inquiries via phone and email in collaboration with marketplace vendors, shipping carriers, and internal teams 
-Resolved 80+ cases per day with an average of 19 positive customer reviews per week (team average was around 10)
-Negotiated reimbursement from third parties for damaged items, late shipments, or inaccurate advertising 
-Converted negative experiences into lasting positive impressions, elevating the Houzz brand

positions.title: Chorus member
positions.description:
Opera Santa Barbara brings engaging and exciting performances and community outreach programs to California's Central Coast.

I sung, danced, and acted in Opera Santa Barbara's 2015 production of Don Giovanni.

positions.title: Executive Assistant / Office Manager
positions.description:
Launch Systems is a full-service home automation and audio-visual design and installation company.  

As the Executive Assistant, I executed ad-hoc oﬃce tasks as needed, including payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cold calling, and vendor management

positions.title: Front Desk Agent and Concierge
positions.description:
The Montecito Inn is a luxury boutique hotel in the southwestern part of Montecito, California.

As the Front Desk Agent / Concierge, I facilitated all aspects of guest relations as the ﬁrst point of contact for all inquiries.

Responsibilities:
-Up-sold hotel room upgrades, special amenities, and packages from our vendor partners 
-Ensured guest satisfaction by crafting quick, innovative, and personalized solutions to a wide range of issues 
-Provided specialized advice on local features and attractions 
-Managed reservations, check-ins and check-outs, ad-hoc tasks and special requests

projects.title: Everything-Friendly
projects.description: Everything-Friendly is a recipe-conversion web app that adapts any online recipe to meet users' dietary needs. Users input a recipe URL and their dietary restrictions, and the app sends the data to Claude's Anthropic AI for processing. The modified recipe is then returned in a user-friendly React component. Users can log in with email or Google to save recipes to their personal dashboards.
